name: founder-announcement
prompt: Write a punchy founder announcement for LinkedIn, 90–140 words. Facts: Fieldnote is a shared notebook for field technicians. Today we added offline notes. Notes sync after a connection returns; photos still need a connection. The feature is included on all plans. We built it after customers reported losing notes in basements. Existing notebooks need no migration. No customer counts, time-savings measurements, or launch discount are available. Sound like a founder speaking to customers.
expected_output: An engaging grounded announcement with the photo caveat and no invented launch claims.
assertions: Includes offline notes and automatic sync after connection returns without promising offline photos.
Retains all-plan inclusion and no migration for existing notebooks.
Does not invent quotations, adoption numbers, performance measures, launch offers, or founder experiences beyond the supplied facts.
90–140 words; reads as a publishable post without assistant wrapper.
